title: R′ Badan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin cites it as a sage’s name. Hyman says he has found it nowhere except Rosh Hashanah 25b, “Bedan in his generation is like Aaron in his generation,” where it refers to Samson, who came from Dan.[^1]

notes.text: Rosh Hashanah 25b gives “Bedan in his generation, like Aaron in his generation”; the preceding 25a passage identifies Bedan with Samson and explains the name as coming from Dan. Yuchasin’s alleged sage entry has not been directly collated. Hyman’s statement that he found no other occurrence is retained as his observation, without claiming an exhaustive search. Hyman’s abbreviated heading ר׳ is retained as R′ rather than expanded.
